Hi Emma / Sam —

Thanks again for taking the discovery this morning. Quick recap: we confirmed Greenleaf's primary need is a low-latency, private inference option for real-time transcription and downstream clinical NLP. You mentioned tight procurement windows and a short internal approval path, so I want to propose a concrete next step: a 30-minute technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer (Ben) to walk architecture, security posture, and a short demo of latency profiles on comparable workloads.

Suggested slots (please confirm the one that works):
- Wed, Mar 31 — 10:30–11:00 AM PT (preferred)
- Thu, Apr 1 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

Because your calendar looked constrained and we've had a few follow-up slots open up quickly this week, can you confirm within 6 hours of this email? If we don't hear back within that window we'll release the 10:30 slot so other customers can take it — we can always book the fallback on Thu.

Agenda (short):
- 5m intro & goals
- 10m environment & architecture fit (private / VPC options)
- 10m demo: latency/cost tradeoffs, batching, KV cache example
- 5m Q&A + next steps (procurement & pilot timeline)

Attachments: 10m-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (agenda + proposed attendees).

If procurement needs to be on the invite, please CC them and we’ll include a brief procurement checklist in the meeting.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Apologies — Sam had an urgent ops incident this morning which is why we missed the tail end of the call. Appreciate the recap.

We absolutely want the technical deep-dive. A couple of constraints on our side:
- Procurement needs a heads-up and will want the procurement checklist before they sign off on a pilot. I looped them in above.
- Our engineering lead is only available late mornings or after 3pm PT.
- We have a standing all-hands Thu afternoon, so Thu 2:00–2:30 clashes for us.

If you can do a Wed late-morning slot that would work best. Otherwise we can look at Mon/next Tue.

Would you be able to offer a locked window Thu 11:15–11:45 AM PT as a secondary option? I know that’s tighter than usual but it’s the only non-conflicting window we can promise at the moment.
